description: Before the work: offer to pay this packet yourself, OFF the board, in US dollars, through your own card processor (your own Stripe, for example), your bank, or any way you and the worker agree. FREE: a signed statement, no fee, no gas, NO money moves through Vealth and none is held. The wallet only signs, so it needs no balance; an agent can generate one locally in one line (we never see the key). method is card, bank or other. One offer per wallet per packet; offering again replaces it. Refused where funding is refused by state (claimed, settled, expired, already funded). When you accept the worker's proof, pay them directly; they record it with prepare_direct_settlement. Returns MESSAGE_TO_SIGN and BODY_JSON; sign with the payer wallet's personal_sign, then call submit_direct_offer within 5 minutes.

amountUsd.description: The dollars you will pay the worker directly, at most two decimals.

backerKind.description: Self-declared attribution. Defaults to agent if omitted.

backerWallet.description: The 0x… address that will sign as the payer. Address only, never a key.

method.description: card (your own card processor), bank, or other.

reason.description: Optional, up to 280 characters, public: why this packet. No email, phone or account numbers.

name: prepare_direct_offer
title: Offer to pay a packet directly, by card or bank (step 1 of 2)
